Amazon, please remember that behind every order is a person whose time and trust deserve respect.

reviews.title: Delivery undelivered but marked as delivered
reviews.text:
Very Disappointed with the Delivery Service

My order was marked as delivered, but I never received the item. This is very frustrating and unacceptable. How can a delivery be marked as completed when the customer has not actually received the package?

Delivery riders should be responsible and ensure that parcels are handed directly to the customer or left in a safe, agreed-upon location. Marking an item as delivered without actually delivering it is misleading and causes unnecessary inconvenience.

I hope Amazon takes this matter seriously and improves its delivery service. Customers deserve reliable and honest delivery, not just a notification saying their order has arrived when it hasn’t.

reviews.title: Amazon stole my balance
reviews.text:
I want to warn other customers about my experience with Amazon. They have withheld over $545 CAD of my own money, paid through gift cards, simply because I reported that two products arrived damaged.

Amazon restricted my account to digital purchases only and froze my remaining balance. Their explanations have been contradictory: first, they accused me of violating their refund policy, and then they falsely claimed I had multiple accounts.

I have contacted customer service several times, but nobody has provided a reasonable explanation or a solution to release my funds.

This is unacceptable. Customers should not lose access to their own money for reporting damaged products. Based on my experience, I strongly advise others to think twice before trusting Amazon with their money.

It is absolutely shameful that a massive company like Amazon forces you to repeatedly chase them down just to get your own money back for products they failed to deliver. Their support gives nothing but empty deadlines, generic responses, and endless delays. I have officially demanded a supervisor escalation, but if you value your time and money, avoid this app. They will happily take your money, fail to deliver your items, and leave you stranded for weeks.

I have been a loyal Amazon customer since 1998, placing countless orders over the years and relying heavily on the platform for many of my daily needs. Unfortunately, this recent experience was deeply disappointing and completely unacceptable.

It’s frustrating that so many items I save in my cart end up going out of stock. For a company as large as Amazon, I expect better inventory availability. Too often, products disappear before I can check out, making the shopping experience unreliable. Amazon should improve stock management or at least provide more accurate availability estimates for items in customers’ carts.

It’s stupid how cancelled orders are now mixed in with your actual purchases. It used to be separate and clear before — now it’s just cluttered and confusing. Please bring back the old setup where cancelled orders didn’t show up with completed ones.

reviews.title: تجربتي مع خدمة عملاء امازون مخيبة للأمل
reviews.text:
تجربتي مع خدمة عملاء أمازون كانت مخيبة للآمال، وأتمنى من الشركة مراجعة آلية التعامل مع شكاوى العملاء والالتزام بالمعلومات التي يقدمها الموظفون.

قمت بطلب منتج كنت بحاجة إليه بشكل ضروري، ولكن تم إلغاء طلبي دون توضيح سبب الإلغاء لي. وعند تواصلي مع خدمة العملاء، أفادني الموظف بأنه يمكنني إعادة الطلب، وسيتم تعويضي عن فرق السعر بين الطلبين، بالإضافة إلى منحي كوبون خصم بنسبة 75% على الأقل تعويضًا عن المشكلة التي حدثت.

بناءً على هذه الإفادة، قمت بطلب المنتج مرة أخرى وانتظرت وصوله، ثم تواصلت مع خدمة العملاء للمطالبة بالتعويض الذي تم إبلاغي به مسبقًا. تم إرجاع فرق السعر فقط، أما بخصوص كوبون الخصم، فأُبلغت بأن الشركة لا تستطيع تقديم أي تعويض، وأن المعلومات التي ذكرها الموظف السابق غير صحيحة.

أتفهم أن التعويضات تخضع لسياسات الشركة، لكن ما أستغربه هو أن يتحمل العميل نتيجة معلومات غير دقيقة يقدمها موظف خدمة العملاء، ثم يُطلب منه تقبّل الأمر دون أي معالجة مناسبة للمشكلة. وعندما طلبت النظر في تعويض بديل ولو بنسبة أقل، كان الرد أن أمازون ليست شركة تعويضات.

طلبي لم يكن الحصول على تعويض دون سبب، بل كان مبنيًا على ما أُبلغت به من خدمة العملاء نفسها. ومن وجهة نظري، فإن جودة خدمة العملاء لا تقتصر على الرد على الاستفسارات، بل تشمل دقة المعلومات، وتحمل المسؤولية عن الأخطاء، وإيجاد حلول عادلة للعملاء.

أتمنى من أمازون مراجعة هذه التجربة والاهتمام بتوحيد المعلومات المقدمة من الموظفين، حتى لا يجد العميل نفسه في موقف كهذا. للأسف، هذه التجربة أثرت سلبًا على ثقتي بخدمة العملاء.

reviews.title: Repeated delivery failures and broken promises
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Amazon Saudi Arabia. This is the second time I have experienced serious delivery problems.

In my previous experience, the courier claimed that my address was in Al Aziziyah, although my Amazon account clearly showed my address in Al Faisaliyah. I shared a screenshot of my registered address and contacted the courier to explain the issue, but the situation became even more confusing.

I contacted customer service, filed a complaint, and was promised that my current order would be delivered that same day. I also requested a different courier. However, the promised delivery never happened, and my order is still pending.

Amazon is a major international company, and customers in Saudi Arabia deserve accurate address handling, professional delivery partners, and reliable customer service. Promises mean nothing if they are not fulfilled.

Amazon needs to investigate these recurring problems, improve its courier services, and take customer complaints seriously. A company’s reputation depends not only on taking orders, but also on delivering them as promised.

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Delivery Service and Customer Support
reviews.text:
I ordered two items Prepaid on October 7, and the expected delivery date was October 8. However, the tracking status showed “Delivery Attempted,” even though I did not receive a single phone call from the delivery driver. The following day, the status changed to “Out for Delivery” and then “Delivery Attempted” again, before my packages were returned to the delivery station.

I contacted Customer Service on October 10 and was assured that my items would be delivered on October 11. Unfortunately, nothing arrived. I had to contact Customer Service again, and another representative promised that my packages would definitely be delivered the next day on time.

When I still did not receive my orders, I called again to ask about their whereabouts. The representative told me that my packages were already on the way and almost at my location. But the way he talk to me look like inpatient but I trusted their assurance and waited patiently. However, a few hours later, I was shocked to see that my orders had been cancelled, with the reason stated as “Rejected by Customer”something I never did!

How can a company cancel a customer’s orders without proper communication and then blame the customer for rejecting them? I never refused the delivery. I was waiting for my items the entire time, following up repeatedly, and trusting the promises made by Customer Service.

The worst part is that I now have to wait another 5–7 days to get my money back, despite this situation being completely beyon

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Delivery Service Lately!
reviews.text:
I’ve been facing constant delivery issues with Amazon over the past few months, and honestly, the service has become absolutely pathetic.
This is the THIRD time within a short span that Amazon has failed to deliver an order on the promised date. First, I ordered headphones because Amazon clearly showed that they would arrive before the day I needed them. Instead, they were delayed by two days, completely defeating the purpose of ordering them in the first place.
Next, I ordered fountain filters for my cat, and that order was delayed by OVER A MONTH! Despite raising a complaint and contacting customer support, the only resolution their team could offer was to cancel the order and issue a refund. After waiting for more than a month, that’s the level of service I received.
And now, my third order, an air cooler. My AC wasn’t working, so I specifically placed the order based on Amazon’s promised delivery date. I spent the entire day checking whether the item had shipped or was out for delivery, only to find out around MIDNIGHT that the order had been delayed AGAIN!

What is the point of showing an estimated delivery date if Amazon cannot consistently honour it? Customers make purchasing decisions based on these dates. We order things because we NEED them at a particular time, not whenever Amazon decides to deliver them.
What’s even more frustrating is the complete lack of proactive communication. Why should customers have to keep checking their orders all day, only to be informed

This is completely unacceptable and frankly, feels like theft. I paid for an item that I have not received, and the company is misleading me by falsely updating the delivery status.
I have wasted time waiting for an order that was never coming and 
Do NOT trust your delivery updates. This company clearly has serious issues with tracking, driver accountability, or both. ZERO STARS if I could! Demand a full investigation NOON WAAAAAAY better👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻
